_comment: Disease states for graph matching (Documentation/design/graph-normalization.md#ranking). They apply to a paper on one of the patient's cancers; a disease profile adds the states of its disease, and patterns for one of these states under its id (data/profiles). A paper is about a state when its title matches `title` (case-insensitive, JavaScript) or one of `mesh` is a major topic. A patient is in a state when an active statement has one of `concepts`, or an entity name matches `names` (German and English, after normalizeName). An `advanced` state puts screening, surveillance and localized disease behind the patient. Which states contradict each other is in stages.ts.
